notes.title: Warsaw. The pearl of the north.
notes.content:
Warsaw. The pearl of the north. This was the name of the capital of Poland before the Second World War. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/3d14041f6f191d32cb6eabfd977430dfd69cc462.png[/img]

Seventy-seven years ago, on August 1, 1944, the Warsaw Uprising started. After its fall, the Germans decided to destroy the whole city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/c28f259c130cda367df639d9e1d92f486eb3ed43.png[/img]

 Nazi troops were ordered to plunder, burn and destroy tenement houses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/b142e7007035344f6926f6f6ef7158946b2909f3.jpg[/img]

The historical fragment of the city was recreated in the Land of War game. We have an opportunity to visit it before the massive demolition.

notes.title: On August 17, 1940
notes.content:
On August 17, 1940, Nazis who occupied the city of Krakow destroyed Adam Mickiewicz Monument. The monument, which stood in the main square continuously since 1898. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/a0baaeeb5957dd45212ca83eb81e0681d5d77bd7.jpg[/img]

It was found in pieces shortly after the war in 1946 in the scrapyard in Hamburg.

Below we present a song from the Land of War called "Müller".

[url=https://youtu.be/H2xTXYTxcJA]Land of War - Soundtrack: Müller[/url]

We also encourage you to read the article [url=http://jawnesny.pl/2021/07/land-of-war-muzyka-poczatku-wojny/]ARTICLE[/url] , which mainly focuses on the aspect of music in the game.

All the songs from the Land of War may be ordered as DLC Land of War Soundtrack.

notes.title: 11 August 1944
notes.content:
On August 11, 1944, the Germans seized the Wola and Ochota districts in Warsaw. The place of defense was attacked in the morning by artillery, goliaths, tanks, and infantry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/fafd2c93cb57c8760e07911d8f6f2e59b92bf665.png[/img]

 One of the important strategic elements for the insurgents was the Gasworks in Wola. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/6ee3ba9a6d021e7a585cd8c8fd829770a81087dd.png[/img]

We recreated the mentioned location in the Land of War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/3065899e56a28d465720001edde72751c162d3ae.png[/img]

notes.title: 4 august 1944
notes.content:
On August 4, 1944, for the first time since the beginning of the Warsaw Uprising, planes with supplies for the insurgents fighting for freedom appeared over the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/de7513a699a3d58ced5ff9451985e7985149dac5.jpg[/img]

Three crews under the command of Captain Stanisław Daniel, Lieutenant Tadeusz Nencki, and Second Lieutenant Stanisław Kleybor carried out successful airdrops in the area of ​​the cemetery in Wola, where the "Radosław" group was fighting. The airdrops were made between 00:48 and 01:43 a.m.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/f40bb247c3a67bec15b567fb388d710b94b4cb66.jpg[/img]

At that time, the inhabitants of Warsaw were building barricades in a hurry, fighting and waiting for backup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/b142e7007035344f6926f6f6ef7158946b2909f3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Land of War - The Beginning patch 1.1
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

The time around the premiere is a time of hard work for us. We collected all the feedback from you, the players, and prepared a patch that will solve most of the urgent issues. 
The patch is called v1.1, the changelog is available below. 

Improvements

• The in-game tutorial for grenades has been added
• The ability to select the force of Camera Shake for the Incoming Hits has been added
• Two game modes have been added – Classic Mode and Casual Mode (reduced damage, faster health regeneration, lower frequency of enemy attacks).
• Several fixes to dialogues have been added to the Hold the Line map
• Dead bodies on the Hold the Line map fixed
• Fixes for handling custom game controllers have been added
• Explosion impact improved

Fixes

• Added option for reversed mouse axis
• Save system improvements
• The behavior of medics on the Hold the Line map has been corrected
• The environment on the Dante’s Inferno map has been improved
• Fixed some visual artifacts on The Beginning map
• The rotation speed of the guns on the armored train has been increased
• Improved camera operation during sequences with an armored train
• The range of combat zones on The Beginning map has been corrected to prevent a death loop at the start of a location
• The Admiral's conversation animation on the English version of The Almo‘39 has been improved
• The behavior of the Admiral on The Almo‘39 has been corrected
• The pyrotechnic effects on the Almo‘39 map have been corrected
• Blocker in the sewer tunnel has been removed (Dante’s Inferno map)
• The size of shield collisions has been corrected in various places in the game
• The movement of the character's mouth on the Hold the Line map has been corrected
• Several dialogue lines have been improved
• The visuals on The Beginning map have been improved - the drawing range of vegetation has been increased
• The lighting on The Beginning map in the bunker has been corrected
• Lighting fixes have been added to the Death from Above map
• Added Amendments to the naming of military ranks in German

We don't want to finish over here, but provide you more updates and continue to collect your feedback. We're aware that some things may have been better here or there, but we're not hiding. In fact, we thank you for all your support and want to improve the game further. More information below.


Patch 1.2 (planned date 16th of June)
 
• Performance and memory usage improvements
• Fire FX improved
• Sound system improvements
• Localisation fixes
• Multiple animations improvements
• Overall balance improvements
• Stability fixes
• Multiple fixes to prevent users to go outside of the map area

We hope that this update will improve your experience with the Land of War game. 
Thank you for supporting us, we’ll continue to bring the updates. 

MS Games Team

notes.title: MS Games’ official statement concerning the delayed release of Land of War
notes.content:
Dear Gamers, 

The last 48 hours were the most difficult moment for us in the development of Land of War: The Beginning. In our game we wanted to present the most accurate representation of the historical events from the beginning of WW2. Our plans had to be confronted with the legal reality of game publishing. As a private, entity Steam sets standards for content on their platform and is also subject to regulations on all markets, worldwide.

Because of these rules we were obliged to change some of the content in Land of War: The Beginning in the last two days (and nights). The alterations are related to the use of nazi symbols, which in some territories can’t be present in works of fiction (even historical fiction), without an approval of proper authorities. The game has again been submitted again for review by Steam. After receiving approval it will be available for players as soon as possible. We will inform you about the new release date in a separate message. In the meantime we are working on a patch, which will restore the removed imagery in territories where the law allows their presence in a proper context.

In the last days we received a lot of support from the community, but also some criticism. The last three years have been a period of hard work, and the last few days were highly intense. We want Land of War to reach you as fast as possible and want to apologize for the inconvenience.


On behalf of MS Games
Sebastian Binik

VIS P-35!
This is the German version of the legendary Polish wz. 35 VIS. After taking over the F.B. Radom factory, the Wehrmacht resumed production in 1940 under the name P-35(p) removing the Polish emblem and the year of production. In total the occupants produced 312,000 pieces in several versions, which were gradually simplified.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/3c6df6b432e1bcc97de8d13e01acaa08dc5cd20c.png[/img]

Revolver Nagant wz. NG 30!

It was a weapon produced in Poland by F.B. Radom under a licence bought in Belgium. 19,000 pieces were produced, of which 15,700 went into the armament of the National Police.

Saber wz.1921!
It was introduced into the army in 1921 and used until 1939 as individual armament for soldiers of the mounted artillery squadrons, light artillery regiments, squadrons of the Border Protection Corps, tabors and “Krakus” divisional cavalry.

notes.title: Land of War - The Beginning: Trailer 🎖️
notes.content:
Land of War is set in a part of WW2 history often neglected by video games - the nazi invasion of Poland in September 1939. As a Polish soldier, gamers will visit the most important battlefields of this campaign, such as the battle of Mokra, the siege of Warsaw or the defense of the Hel peninsula.

Waiting for help from their Western allies that never came, players will try to fend off the nazi invaders, using historically accurate weaponry and multiple prototypes, which in reality never reached the frontline in time. The developers also prepared some “what-if” scenarios, based on unrealized battleplans of both sides of the conflict.

[previewyoutube=nSogYfsrxPU;full][/previewyoutube]

Players can take screenshots of Land of War using Nvidia Ansel, a tool that allows free camera movement and adds a variety of filters and effects to the final picture.

notes.title: 7TP - Polish light tank of the Second World War.
notes.content:
Dear players 

We want to present model of the 7TP (siedmiotonowy polski - 7-tonne Polish) was a Polish light tank of the Second World War. It was developed from the British Vickers 6-ton. A standard tank of the Polish Army during the 1939 Invasion of Poland, its production did not exceed 150 vehicles. Its chassis was used as the base for the C7P artillery tractor.

[url=https://skfb.ly/6ZLFr]CHECK OUT ON SKETCHFAB[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/a47af59c97750c218baf960d213dad4fa4b0437a.png[/img]

All 7TP tanks took part in combat in the defence of Poland during the German Invasion of Poland in 1939. Most of them were attached to two light tank battalions (the 1st and the 2nd). The remaining tanks, that is the ones used for training as well as tanks that were finished after the outbreak of the war, were used in an improvised tank unit fighting in the defence of Warsaw. Although technically superior to any of the German light tanks of the era, the 7TP was too scarce to change the outcome of the war.

notes.title: PZL P.11 - a Polish fighter aircraft
notes.content:
We want to present model of the Polish PZL P.11 fighter in which you will have the opportunity to fight an air battle in the game Land of War. 

And now a bit of history 

PZL P.11c - Polish fighter aircraft designed by engineer Zygmunt Puławski before World War II. Produced in Poland at the PZL factory in 1934–1936, and also under license at the IAR company in Romania. Colloquially known as the "eleven", it is considered a symbol of the Polish military aviation during the September II world war campaign. Due to it low small weight , the PZL P11c plane could perform sharp maneuvers, a dive flight that ended with a quick lift of the plane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/b8b15f53313e00a777e639e35f9445fcf3449f3d.png[/img]

[url=https://skfb.ly/6Z96W]CHECK ON SKETCHFAB[/url]

The first fight

Before At 7 a.m. on September 1, 1939, the P.11c squad from the 121st squadron, led by the squadron commander, Capt. Mieczysław Medwecki took off from the airfield. Shortly after take-off, Medwecki had been surprised and shot down by a Junkers Ju 87 bomber pilot returning from an air raid on Krakow, becoming the first Polish and Allied pilot to fall during World War II.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/dd7f2aa4ff628952e81c49a5f145fbf58c829d94.jpg[/img]

Today, the only surviving copy of P.11c is in the collection of the Polish Aviation Museum in Krakow.

notes.title: Land of War - The Beginning - 🔉THRIC3 official music video🔉
notes.content:
Land of War: The Beginning is the first shooter taking place during the nazi invasion of Poland in September 1939, which was the initial moment of World War II. The game’s developer and publisher, MS Games, released a new music video showcasing the upcoming production.


Thanks to the cooperation with a reenactment group - SRH Bateria Motorowa Artylerii Przeciwlotniczej, the studio had an opportunity to create the music video using original uniforms and soldiers’ equipment from September 1939. In the music video, you can see many iconic locations that have been reconstructed in the game, such as the Castle Square in Warsaw, Warsaw gasworks or the Hel peninsula with the legendary artillery battery of H. Laskowski.


[previewyoutube=iJVBM-1ZqeY;full][/previewyoutube]

-In collaboration with artists, we managed to prepare a dynamic and modern song that talks about the war zone. - says Mateusz Stabryła, the Head of Production. The song itself aims to bring the ideas of Land of War to a wider range of people thanks to a modernist approach to editing and creation. – says Sebastian Binik - Head of Marketing in MS GAMES. The combination of live-action shots with in-game gameplay has an interesting, intertwining effect. -  Sebastian Binik adds.

notes.title: Samochód pancerny wz. 28 ("armored car, year 1928 model")
notes.content:
Samochód pancerny wz. 28 (literally "Armoured car, year 1928 model") was a Polish armored car of the 1920s. 
Based on the French-built Citroën-Kegresse B2 10CV half-track chassis, the vehicle became the standard armored car of the Polish Army. However, due to low speed and problems with reliability in 1933 the vehicles were returned to the factory and rebuild as all-wheel Samochód pancerny wz. 34.

[url=https://skfb.ly/6ZoGE]CHECK ON SKETCHFAB[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/0648ccc3a076e336389e16813e8d1d42ca7220bb.png[/img]

The cars came in one of two basic variants: one armed with a 37 mm Puteaux SA 18 gun, the other with one Ckm wz. 25 Hotchkiss machine gun. By 1939 all but a handful (3 or 4) were converted to wz. 34 armored cars, the remainder remained in training centers.

notes.title: Land of War Developers Diary #2 Environment
notes.content:
Every experienced player knows how much impact the right balance of guns has on the gameplay. A wrong setup can spoil the pleasure of playing even in the biggest productions with huge budgets.
That's why we've paid a lot of attention to the proper balancing of individual weapons. We'll tell you more about this in the next article.

[previewyoutube=qCG5vOP7aSw;full][/previewyoutube]

Following the latest trends, and taking care of the highest level of immersion, we decided to take a closer look at our individual scenes, as well as the entire locations, and do a significant graphic correction.
We paid special attention to vegetation, diversity, color, and placement. It's mostly about good color composition and blending together with other objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/497b27fa6c67187ef1dd1215fb37a06a002368d7.jpg[/img]

The next step was to adjust the light, its temperature, and intensity to show what's best in the scene. This is a very difficult task, but at the same time crucial for the final visual perception of the maps. Playing with the lights allows us to expose interesting elements of the game, such as buildings, vehicles, and sometimes guns. With the whole lightning, we can also build climate, emotions, and even lead the player to a specified place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/77e0adf3ae9a47b299eeeb414e3c25bfceb3829f.png[/img]

Through the process of redesigning the scenes, we must balance realism, playability, and delightful visual effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/240075dafa67db3c9f7d3335e22e80f67906f223.jpg[/img]

notes.title: September 1st, 1939
notes.content:
Early morning, September 1st, 1939, the biggest conflict in the world's history began, which consumed millions of lives. The German war machine started invading Poland.
You are thrown into the chaos of war as Peter Kowalski, a soldier of the Polish army. Face the enemy using heavy vehicles, tanks, and planes. You will use an entire range of arsenals from the era, conceptual, and prototype weapons that occasionally appeared on battlefields. Fight alongside your companions in locations that have never been shown in FPS games before. Resist a massive armored attack under the village of Mokra operating an armored train, protect and fight for the Vistula river bridge under cover of the night. Do a quiet interview on the streets of the historic Warsaw old town. Protect the beaches of the Hel peninsula. Watch out for every word, step, and gesture. Only intelligent and appropriate decisions will decide whether you survive or not.
In Honor and Memory of the Heroes.

notes.title: Land of War - game characters revealed! We present Muller.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aXVexumfz44;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Muller [/b]is a fictional character of a German officer. An inspiration for him came - among others - from Wernher von Braun, German scientist, a pioneer of rocket technology and co-author of V2 flying bomb, who later became American aerospace engineer. A lot of influence on Muller also came from a book by Rudolf Lusar “German secret weapons of the Second World War”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/2fa45fba4b454ae81cc7aaf05a6fd2edab03c285.png[/img]

Muller is an embodiment of a frantic pursuit of world domination, disregarding costs of it to mankind. He plays a crucial role in the Land of War story. He is the arch enemy, the oppressor who madly and relentlessly fights to protect his greatest work, mysteries of which the player will slowly be uncovering during the game. Will he succeed?

That is up to Piotr Kowalski, the main character, who gets entangled in an espionage affair, leading to a discovery of the biggest, most advanced technological project of the 3rd Reich - a weapon so potent, it may easily destroy the world as we know it.

“It is thanks to Muller and his bodyguards, that the player will be able to obtain conceptual weapons and vehicles, which were either very rare or never made it to the real front.” - says Sebastian Binik, Head of marketing at MS Games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/c133b143abb780268b2bd0afe58700dee8b64138.png[/img]

Muller is a mixture of many fabular toposes (albo game villains) known from classic WWII games and literature. His mysterious appearance and expressive character gives extra depth to this key figure and main antagonist and really defines the gameplay.

“When paying Land of War one must pay attention to the way the story unveils, as it may turn out there is much more than just the wartime story that Muller and Kowalski have in common.” - Sebastian Binik.

notes.title: Developers Diary #2 Land of War and historical events
notes.content:
An essential part of the concept behind Land of War is a thorough reconstruction of real, historical events and places. In today’s article we briefly how we find a balance between playability and historical facts.

Everything starts with research.

We started our work on the game from collecting dozens of memories, stories and historical descriptions from WWII events that took place on Polish soil. In particular, we were interested in September 1939 defensive war against Nazi Germany, but we also searched for inspiration in the depiction of later resistance and sabotage actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/447030677273ed2fc7ed086071b5749d5f89c9d3.jpg[/img]

We quickly realized that – despite losing the first accord of WWII – this part of the war was so incredibly rich with heroic deeds and twists of fate, it is this moment in history we want to depict in Land of War. So we focused on numerous, sometimes hardly known episodes of this hot and dry September 1939.

We have seen two more advantages of choosing this particular moment in time as the canvas for the game: first, no one ever made a game about these events, second, the weapons and vehicles used in this phase of WWII were hard – if ever – used in games.

How did we fit our plot into historical events.

After long discussions form the whole gathered material, we picked some 20 stories which, for various reasons, appealed to us the most and only then our real research. To make sure we understand how an event took place, where who was involved, what tactics and equipment were used, we traveled to see the place ourselves. We took lots of pictures, visited local museums, bought books on the topic and talked to custodians of such places. Undoubtedly, a major part of the job was done on the Internet, by browsing on-line archive resources and contacting reconstruction groups and history aficionados.

For each location, we had to find out which army units were involved and – as a result – what type of equipment, weapons, and uniforms could be used on both sides of the conflict. We also wanted to show less known, conceptual weapons, native to this war theater and not utilized in later stages of WWII, because Polish equipment was not used by other armies and German equipment was quickly replaced with newer constructions, created on the basis of experience gathered during the Polish campaign.

Because our game is a traditional FPS we had to adjust some aspects of history. Either the battlefield was too big and would take hours to pass, too plain, so there was nowhere to hide or we added trenches and ditches, so our hero could sneak in and out of places unnoticed. The goal was to keep the location graphically attractive and interesting to play. On the other hand, some locations were so iconic we decided we should not change anything there and adjusted our plot instead.

Another important job was to find references for structures and machinery critical to the location but entirely destroyed during the conflict. Sometimes national archives were the place to go, other times we used sources as exotic as eBay or internet arms auctions.

To get a better feeling of depicted events, some of us sent to a shooting range, where they could understand the intensity and loudness of a battlefield and well as contemplate the sheer force of a kickback when shooting Mauser 1898 rifle and other weapons.

It took a lot of effort to convert collected materials into the interesting plots and great gaming experiences. Maintaining a proper balance between staying true to historic facts and requirements of playability resulted in a product that will provide players a very satisfying experience.

notes.title: Developer’s Diary no. 1 LAND OF WAR LEVEL DESIGN
notes.content:
[b]Location design is a major element of any game development project. Our aim here at Land of War development team is to create locations which are as close to real battlefields of September 1939 Poland as possible but also provide interesting and dynamic gameplay so typical for old school FPS shooters.[/b]

[h2]Good research is a key[/h2]

We always start with thorough research. If possible (and feasible) we visit the physical location of a battlefield we are working on, see local museums or displays and talk to custodians of such places. We take lots of pictures! Next, we come back to the office and start creating the land. Then we apply white boxes and cylinders representing various objects, vehicles or army units. In this way we can roughly sketch the gameplay and decide to modify the land in order to make it more suitable for our needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/fdfae4313de551598c591ce5725aff4f7ba6e441.jpg[/img]

[h2]How we create locations for Land of War?[/h2]

Another stage is to enrich the environment of our location with objects such as  vegetation, trenches, creeks, chapels, anything we find necessary to make it interesting and supporting the main mission as well as any side tasks. And the we test, test, test to make sure players will be provided with hours of quality playtime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/c48fdbae3d7545c48a544b76ceaee188ac0f8f37.jpg[/img]

“We believe that such approach to level design will make Land of War a very unique experience for everyone looking for games taking place during WWII” – says Bartosz Romanowski, Land of War Level Designer.

Thanks to such framework, we pay a lot of attention to each location in Land of War and make it highly playable. We also take care that each of them contains some specific places, buildings, vehicles and weapons that have never been used in WWII games before. It is these details – we believe – that will make Land of War special and rich with new experiences for all players.
